environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_ID credential for the Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPLE_BUSINESS_KEY_ID credential for the Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPLE_BUSINESS_PRIVATE_KEY credential for the Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional override; leave blank. A bearer token minted elsewhere: while set, it is the run's whole identity. It replaces any configured or saved account, requests send it, its data stays in its own local store, the private key is not read and nothing is minted or saved. It expires in an hour and is not renewed.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transpor

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank. Defaults to Apple's token endpoint at https://account.apple.com/auth/oauth2/token.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Apple Business requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
